newsitem.title: UK: Euromoney to buy rest of Latin Finance.
newsitem.headline: Euromoney to buy rest of Latin Finance.

text.p: Euromoney Publications Plc said on Monday it conditionally agreed to buy the outstanding 49 percent minority interest in its Latin Finance businesses for about 5.0 million stg in stock.
The company said the minority interests were held by two U.S. companies, Allied Communications International Inc and Allied Consultants International Inc.
Euromoney said it would issue up to 384,024 new ordinary shares for the acquisition, which was conditional on Latin Finance achieving certain profit thresholds in the year ending September 30, 1998.
The deal was expected to be completed on or about January 31, 1999.
The market value of the new shares would not exceed 10 million stg, the company said.
